identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.03] Complete the live Polis roster and agent presence model

values.summary: Implemented a Runtime-owned, policy-filtered, bounded local agent roster with truthful Shepherd admission, presence freshness, stable identity, revision-bound pagination, Runtime reincarnation handling, accessible Observatory selection and navigation, and Guardian-owned asynchronous restart proof. The candidate remains unpushed and unpublished for final independent review.
actual_changes: Added the production local roster model, deterministic policy filtering, bounded page tokens, presence/freshness transitions, stable identity, and relocation semantics.
Projected admitted Shepherd truth through Runtime v3 and versioned OpenAPI without claiming distributed or global roster completeness.
Integrated bounded roster selection, cursor/incarnation reset, accessible persistent navigation, and responsive browser behavior in the HTML Observatory.
Routed restart proof through signed Guardian-owned control and made the public result explicitly asynchronous restart acceptance.
Added exact focused, scale, policy, freshness, pagination, reconnect, relocation, status-transition, reincarnation, and browser proof.
